scripts.test:screens: docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -v /work/node_modules -v /work/packages/shared/node_modules -v /work/packages/server/node_modules -v /work/packages/web/node_modules -w /work -e PLAYWRIGHT_SCREENS=1 mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v$(node -p "require('./packages/web/node_modules/@playwright/test/package.json').version")-noble sh -c 'npm install -g --silent $(node -p "require(\"./package.json\").packageManager") && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --store-dir /tmp/pnpm-store && pnpm --filter @cwd/web exec playwright test --project screens "$@"' sh
